title: Field norm and its signed minimal-polynomial formula
statement: Let $K\subseteq L$ be a finite-dimensional extension of fields [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-vector-space-dimension], of degree $d=\dim_K L\geq1$. Define $N_{L/K}(x)=\det_K(z\mapsto xz\mid L)$ [def-weil-endomorphism-determinant]. Then $N_{L/K}(1)=1$, $N_{L/K}(xy)=N_{L/K}(x)N_{L/K}(y)$, and $N_{L/K}(a)=a^d$ for $a\in K$. For $x\in L$, let $P_x(T)\in K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be the minimal polynomial of $x$, namely the unique monic polynomial of least degree annihilating $x$. Put $m=\deg P_x\geq1$, and let $e=\dim_{K(x)}L\geq1$, where $K(x)$ is the smallest subfield of $L$ containing $K$ and $x$. Then $$N_{L/K}(x)=\bigl((-1)^mP_x(0)\bigr)^e.$$ No separability assumption is made.

mathlib_match.how: One declaration per clause: Algebra.norm is the multiplicative determinant map (Mathlib/RingTheory/Norm/Defs.lean:60-64), so preserves one and multiplication; Algebra.norm_algebraMap (Defs.lean:100-101) is the scalar clause. The displayed formula is the one-line rewrite of Algebra.norm_eq_norm_adjoin (Transitivity.lean:229-230) using Algebra.PowerBasis.norm_gen_eq_coeff_zero_minpoly (Mathlib/RingTheory/Norm/Basic.lean:65-68) for IntermediateField.adjoin.powerBasis (Mathlib/FieldTheory/IntermediateField/Adjoin/Basic.lean:451-453), whose generator is x and whose dimension is the minimal-polynomial degree. IntermediateField.minpoly_gen (the same file:384-387) identifies its minimal polynomial with P_x. Integrality of x follows from finite dimensionality; positive dimensions follow since the fields are nonzero. No separability, normality, or characteristic restriction occurs.
